steps.content:
00:30, December, N.F. 113
In front of the Fortuna Theater
This modest three-story building hasn't changed much since your last visit. It is now surrounded by MBCC vehicles, their headlights illuminating its closed door.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the arrest squad is ready. Are we moving in?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's move in. Time for a revisit.
It is pitch-black inside.
With its lights off and its audience gone, the theater is devoid of its usual liveliness. The lonesome stage stands empty and forlorn in the dead silence.
Still, you can sense a Mania Flux lurking in the dark. Wherever she goes, theatrics follows, you think to yourself.
Whoosh...

steps.speaker: Teasing Voice
steps.content: Welcome! Welcome back to the Fortuna Theater!

steps.speaker: Teasing Voice
steps.content: The show hasn't started yet. Please take your seat. And watch your step...
The lights turn on. The theater seems to come alive with the disembodied voice.

steps.speaker: Arrest Squad Member
steps.content: Chief, be careful!

steps.speaker: Teasing Voice
steps.content: We've reserved the best seats for you all. New friends, please proceed to the second floor. You're to enjoy tonight's show from the beginning...
As she says her welcome, the scene in the theater changes, separating you from the members of the arrest squad.

steps.speaker: Teasing Voice
steps.content: As for my dear old friend...

steps.speaker: Teasing Voice
steps.content: Please enter through the special entrance we've prepared for you.
You suddenly find yourself in a passageway leading to the depths of the theater, its end marked by a door that stands ajar.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know full well that I'm not here to watch a show.

Like most rooms in the theater, this one is also comprised of illusions: thick walls, cold lighting, iron tables and chairs... Together, they form the place you're most familiar with: the interrogation room.
Lady Pearl is seated at the table, wearing a smile on her face. When she speaks, her tone is light and airy.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna only puts on one show a year, dear. You're back too soon. The show for this year hasn't started yet.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Or maybe... You've finally succumbed to the appeal of this place and are ready to become the male lead of my show?
steps.female_content: Or maybe... You've finally succumbed to the appeal of this place and are ready to become the female lead of my show?

steps.content: Still wearing her smile, Lady Pearl extends her hand to you, all friendliness and charm, but you know the moment you take her hand, you'll be dragged into one of her shows.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where are the people who came in with me?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Those fellows were not in the mood for a show. So I, kind-hearted as ever, sent them back.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It would be unwise to foist a show on an audience. If the audience isn't happy, the show can only be a flop.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The same goes for actors. Only those who have a strong desire to perform make good actors. It can't be forced.

What you're dealing with is the source of the Mania energy that permeates Fortuna. Her abilities are so closely intertwined with the theater that she could remove the members of the arrest squad from it without anyone being any the wiser.
She taps her fingers on the table, the amusement in her voice growing more obvious.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But you're not like them. As I've said before, you're a performer I've been longing to recruit.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: So, would you like to work with me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But before I come on board, I want to talk to you about something else.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not looking for a part-time job. I'm happy with my day job.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've come to talk about something else.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we have a delicate case on our hands here. The Sinner Bail Regulations have been passed only recently; the public is still sensitive to issues of this nature. The higher-ups want this case handled sensitively.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If you're certain that she is open to negotiation, non-forceful detention can be considered.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Either way, staying safe is your first priority, Chief. Please be careful.
What one individual can do is limited. With only the help of the shackles, you will be hard-pressed to remove this S-Class Sinner from the theater by force.
You need to take an <color=#fb9259>unconventional approach</color> to the problem.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have a proposal for you, madam.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'd like to <color=#fb9259>acquire</color> the Fortuna Theater from you.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Interesting... Never in my life have I met an audience member with such a large appetite.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Any choice is allowed in the Fortuna Theater, if I'm not mistaken. So, shouldn't trading be allowed as well?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides, aren't trade negotiations your area of expertise?

The Fortuna theatrical troupe was formed in N.F. 106. For many years, the troupe staged shows on the outskirts of Eastside. Their performances were fairly popular with certain circles.

In N.F. 112, this small company was acquired. It has since grown into the luxurious immersive theater that it is today.

Lady Pearl, the current owner of the theater, comes from a wealthy business family. In the early years of her career, she involved herself in various business ventures and became an investor of some renown in Eastside.

Upon acquiring Fortuna, she dismissed most of the original members and conducted a complete overhaul. The theater is where it is today all thanks to her.

Nowadays, only one show is produced in Fortuna every year; it never puts on the same show twice, and a completely new group of actors is cast for each show.

In addition, the Intelligence Department has gathered information on all of Lady Pearl's past business dealings—
none of her investments, including the acquisition of Fortuna, ended up in failure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Our intelligence department has looked into the identities of all the actors involved in that night's performance. Some of them were among the audience who came to this theater last year and went missing right afterward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: People are disappearing; Mania is spreading. The MBCC has no choice but to step in to regulate Fortuna's activities.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I don't think you'll come with me this easily, right?
Lady Pearl seems to agree with your assumption, for she gives a smile meant as an invitation for you to continue.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, I'm ready to settle this matter in a different way.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The MBCC is going to make you an offer that you'll be happy with.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: (Sighs)

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Here we go again. I didn't expect you to revive the boring subject of money.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Although I have no intention of selling this precious possession of mine, I guess it wouldn't hurt to hear the offer. What's the number then, my dear?
At the negotiation table, the uninterested seller is waiting for you, the potential buyer, to make an offer.
You make her a generous offer, so generous that you'll have to clear it with the higher-ups.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now that your identity as a Sinner is no longer a secret, there's no way you'll be allowed to run the theater the way you've been running it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If this matter is later left in the hands of the City Council, I can assure you that it'll turn the theater inside out and change it into something you won't even recognize... My goal here is to secure the right to administer the theater for the MBCC.
You make a great show of badmouthing the City Council.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those troupe members who pose no threat will be treated properly. The theater—your most valued asset, I presume—will be kept as it is to the greatest extent possible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The MBCC will provide a sum of money. They can stay on their current career path in the performing arts or pursue new ones. Of course, they'll be subjected to supervision for some time longer, but their freedom won't be restricted.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: On the condition that I agree to detention and leave with you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...That's correct.
The cards have been laid on the table. Lady Pearl lowers her head, as if reflecting, her eyes shielded by the brim of her hat.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Hmm, it sounds tempting.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It's indeed a generous offer, dear. I can see your sincerity.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But I think my theater is worth more than you think.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna was in a real pickle when I took over. It took me quite an effort to turn this losing deal into a profitable one.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If you really want to get me to sell the theater, you'll have to come up with a better, more... interesting offer.
Lady Pearl picks up the report on the table and flicks it with her forefinger. Her gaze is sharp and composed.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Let me teach you a negotiation trick, my dear.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: When you're trying to make a deal, sometimes it's advisable to focus less on the numbers, and more on what the potential seller's actual needs are.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Take me for example. In my eyes, Fortuna is more than just a cash cow.
Lady Pearl's tone takes a dramatic turn. The atmosphere in the room becomes menacing almost instantly, and the overwhelming aura emanating from the Sinner exerts pressure on every inch of your body.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna... What a lovely place! A place where dead dreams are revived, where a beggar gets to be rich, an old man gets to be young again... They know that they're play-acting, and yet they're fully committed to the act.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Here, in this world of make-believe, they see the versions of themselves they want to see, live out the versions of their lives they wish to live out, until their small but bright fires of desire die out...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Their sincerity, their struggle, their passion... To me, that's the true value of Fortuna!
Just like what happened at your first meeting behind the curtain, Lady Pearl's eyes are burning brightly with anticipation, longing, and complex emotions that seem beyond your understanding.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: And I'd do anything to hold on to it.
Cracks begin to appear on the walls. The interrogation room is distorting out of shape as she speaks. Then slowly, she rises to her feet and walks over to your side.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I've seen two incomparable shows here. One was when I first set foot in this place...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The other was when I met you for the first time.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Selling my theater will mean selling the thing that matters the most to me as well. So, my dear, if you want to buy it, you'll have to give me something more.
This is Lady Pearl extending an invitation to you. She holds out her hand, a small pool of Mania energy swirling on her open palm.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If you really want to make a deal with me, well...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Give me two hours of your time. Watch a show with me, my last. I wrote the script. It's scheduled to premiere next year, but I'd like to invite you to watch it with me now.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Bear witness to it with me. Let's refine it together, find a perfect ending for it...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I want to feel that surge of passion again... This is my condition.

There is no denying the sincerity of Lady Pearl's words, but accepting her invitation will be more a gamble than a business transaction. To achieve your goal, however, you have no choice but to venture deep into the lion's den.

options: But I'm not going to be an actor in the show.

choices.text: But I'm not going to be an actor in the show.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just as before, whatever temptation you might come up with is unlikely to work on me.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Of course.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You should know by now that here in Fortuna, if you have no desire to stay, you're free to go whenever you wish.
You shake her hand.

In the blink of an eye, the Mania energy, burning to the touch, spreads from her hand to yours, then to the rest of your body, as the interrogation room shatters into pieces, revealing its true form—the stage of the theater.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You have your deal, my dear.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This will be Fortuna's swan song.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Please, please don't let me down.
